```{r}
# convert to matrix (important for many bioinformatics tools)
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_HPV_Independent)

# remove duplicated gene symbols if any
counts_mat <- counts_mat[!duplicated(rownames(counts_mat)), ]

# create edgeR object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts_mat)

# TMM normalization (library size normalization)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# CPM expression matrix
cpm_mat <- cpm(dge, log = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS: convergence + cut-point tables
# ============================================================================

check_convergence <- function(model, maxit_val) {
  n_iter <- model$iter
  !is.null(n_iter) && all(n_iter < maxit_val) && is.finite(sum(model$coefficients))
}

make_cutoff_table <- function(data, event_var) {
  counts_one <- function(group_col, label) {
    data %>%
      group_by(cell_type, Group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), events = sum(.data[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(threshold_type = label)
  }
  counts <- bind_rows(counts_one("Group_maxstat", "maxstat"),
                      counts_one("Group_median",  "median")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(n, events), values_fill = 0)

  data %>%
    distinct(cell_type, cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median),
                 names_to = "threshold_type", values_to = "cutoff") %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = sub("cutoff_", "", threshold_type)) %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    transmute(cell_type, threshold_type,
              cutoff = signif(cutoff, 3),
              `n (Low/High)`      = paste0(n_Low, "/", n_High),
              `Events (Low/High)` = paste0(events_Low, "/", events_High))
}

add_cutoffs <- function(tab, cutoff_table) {
  tab <- tab %>%
    left_join(cutoff_table, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    relocate(cutoff, `n (Low/High)`, `Events (Low/High)`, .after = threshold_type)
  if ("Variable" %in% names(tab)) {
    keep <- grepl("^Enrichment", tab$Variable)
    tab[!keep, c("cutoff", "n (Low/High)", "Events (Low/High)")] <- NA
  }
  tab$converged <- ifelse(tab$converged, "Yes", "No")
  tab
}
```





#Death 
# Functions to find the cutoffs and thresholds
```{r}
find_maxstat_cutoff <- function(time_var, event_var, fraction_var, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  min_size <- n * 0.45
  max_size <- n * 0.55
  frac <- data[[fraction_var]]
  if (n < 10 ||
      sum(frac >= min(frac, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) < min_size ||
      sum(frac <= max(frac, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) < max_size) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var,
                             ") ~ ", fraction_var))
  MAXSTAT <- tryCatch(
    maxstat::maxstat.test(fmla, data = data, smethod = "LogRank",
                           pmethod = "Lau92", iscores = TRUE,
                           minprop = 0.2, maxprop = 0.8),
    error = function(e) NA
  )
  if (isTRUE(is.na(MAXSTAT))) return(NA_real_)
  MAXSTAT$estimate
}

add_threshold_groups <- function(df, time_var, event_var, fraction_var = "Fraction") {
  df %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_maxstat  = tryCatch(find_maxstat_cutoff(time_var, event_var, fraction_var,
                                                       cur_data_all()),
                                  error = function(e) NA_real_),
      Group_maxstat   = ifelse(!is.na(cutoff_maxstat) & .data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_maxstat,
                                "High", "Low"),
      cutoff_median   = median(.data[[fraction_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Group_median    = ifelse(.data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_median, "High", "Low")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```



```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DISEASE-SPECIFIC DEATH (DSS) ANALYSIS -- MCP-counter
# maxstat + median + continuous Fraction
# ============================================================================

# Reference levels

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- add_threshold_groups(
  analysis_data,

  fraction_var = "Fraction"

analysis_data$Group_maxstat <- relevel(

  ref = "Low"
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# UNIVARIATE DSS
# ============================================================================

run_cox_DSS_group <- function(ct, exposure_var, threshold_label, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ", exposure_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","), converged = check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  )
}

univ_DSS_maxstat_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(cell_types_all, run_cox_DSS_group, exposure_var = "Group_maxstat", threshold_label = "maxstat")
)

univ_DSS_median_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(cell_types_all, run_cox_DSS_group, exposure_var = "Group_median", threshold_label = "median")
)

run_cox_DSS_continuous <- function(ct, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Fraction,
           data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","), converged = check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  )
}

univ_DSS_continuous_all <- bind_rows(lapply(cell_types_all, run_cox_DSS_continuous))

univ_DSS_all_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  univ_DSS_maxstat_all, univ_DSS_median_all, univ_DSS_continuous_all
) %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted <- univ_DSS_all_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
    pval = round(pval, 4),
    p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(cell_type, threshold_type, HR_CI, pval, p_adj_BH, n, n_events, n_iter, converged) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)


univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted <- add_cutoffs(univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted, cutoffs_DSS_mcp)
kable(univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# MCP-counter RFS MULTIVARIATE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================


# ============================================================================
#  REFERENCE LEVELS
# ============================================================================

analysis_data$figo_ini_ava <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$figo_ini_ava),
  ref = "1 (Advanced)"
)

analysis_data$p53_ihc_status <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$p53_ihc_status),
  ref = "Mutant"
)


covariates_full <- c(
  "figo_ini_ava",
  "p53_ihc_status"
)




# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIABLE RFS FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
# This returns the p-value for ALL variables in the model.
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_RFS_MCP <- function(
  cell_type,
  data,
  exposure_var,
  threshold_label,
  covariates,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == !!cell_type)

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Complete-case data
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  model_vars <- c(
    "time_recurrence_surv_60m",
    "recurrence_60m",
    exposure_var,
    covariates
  )

  d <- d %>%
    filter(
      complete.cases(
        across(
          all_of(model_vars)
        )
      )
    )


  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Formula
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
      paste(
        c(
          exposure_var,
          covariates
        ),
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cox-Firth model
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = d,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model failed
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = cell_type,
        threshold_type = threshold_label,
        variable = NA_character_,
        coef = NA_real_,
        HR = NA_real_,
        lower_095 = NA_real_,
        upper_095 = NA_real_,
        pval = NA_real_,
        n = nrow(d),
        n_events = sum(
          d$recurrence_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA_character_,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convergence
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  converged <- check_convergence(
    model,
    maxit_val
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract model results
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    threshold_type = threshold_label,

    variable = names(
      model$coefficients
    ),

    coef = model$coefficients,

    HR = exp(
      model$coefficients
    ),

    lower_095 = model$ci.lower,

    upper_095 = model$ci.upper,

    pval = model$prob,

    n = nrow(d),

    n_events = sum(
      d$recurrence_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),

    converged = converged
  )
}

# ============================================================================

      )
    }
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MEDIAN
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  lapply(
    selected_cell_types_RFS_MCP,
    function(ct) {
      perform_cox_analysis_RFS_MCP(
        cell_type = ct,
        data = analysis_data,
        exposure_var = "Group_median",
        threshold_label = "median",
        covariates = covariates_full
      )
    }
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  lapply(
    selected_cell_types_RFS_MCP,
    function(ct) {
      perform_cox_analysis_RFS_MCP(
        cell_type = ct,
        data = analysis_data,
        exposure_var = "Fraction",
        threshold_label = "continuous",
        covariates = covariates_full
      )
    }

# ============================================================================
# COMBINE MULTIVARIABLE RESULTS
# ============================================================================

multiv_RFS_MCP_selected <- bind_rows(
  multiv_RFS_continuous_MCP_selected,
  multiv_RFS_maxstat_MCP_selected,
  multiv_RFS_median_MCP_selected
)


# ============================================================================
# IDENTIFY EXPOSURE ROWS
# ============================================================================
#
# Only these rows receive BH correction:
#
#   Fraction
#   Group_maxstatHigh
#   Group_medianHigh
#
# FIGO and p53 = FALSE
#
# ============================================================================

multiv_RFS_MCP_selected <- multiv_RFS_MCP_selected %>%
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(

      threshold_type == "continuous" &
        variable == "Fraction" ~ TRUE,

      threshold_type == "maxstat" &
        variable == "Group_maxstatHigh" ~ TRUE,

      threshold_type == "median" &
        variable == "Group_medianHigh" ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )


# ============================================================================
# 12. BH CORRECTION — EXPOSURE TERMS ONLY
# ============================================================================
#
# BH correction is performed separately within each threshold type.
#
# Therefore:
#
#   continuous -> Fraction rows only
#   maxstat    -> Group_maxstatHigh rows only
#   median     -> Group_medianHigh rows only
#
# FIGO and p53 receive NA.
#
# ============================================================================

multiv_RFS_MCP_selected <- multiv_RFS_MCP_selected %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = NA_real_
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      
      exposure_idx <- which(
        .x$exposure &
          !is.na(.x$pval)
      )
      
      if (length(exposure_idx) > 0) {
        
        .x$p_adj_BH[exposure_idx] <-
          p.adjust(
            .x$pval[exposure_idx],
            method = "BH"
          )
      }
      
      .x
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ============================================================================
# 13. FORMATTED MULTIVARIABLE TABLE
# ============================================================================

multiv_RFS_MCP_selected_formatted <- multiv_RFS_MCP_selected %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = case_when(
      grepl("^Group_", variable)         ~ "Enrichment (High vs Low)",
      variable == "Fraction"             ~ "Continuous (per unit)",
      grepl("^figo_ini_ava", variable)   ~ "FIGO (Initial)",
      grepl("^p53_ihc_status", variable) ~ "p53 (Normal)",
      TRUE ~ variable
    ),
    Coef          = round(coef, 4),
    `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f\u2013%.4f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
    `p-value`     = round(pval, 4),
    `p (BH-adj)`  = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(cell_type, threshold_type, Variable, Coef, `HR (95% CI)`, `p-value`,
         `p (BH-adj)`, n, n_events, n_iter, converged) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)

multiv_RFS_MCP_selected_formatted <- add_cutoffs(multiv_RFS_MCP_selected_formatted, cutoffs_RFS_mcp)
kable(multiv_RFS_MCP_selected_formatted,
      caption = "MCP-counter RFS multivariable Cox-Firth analysis")

```


```{r}
library(openxlsx)
tabs <- list(
  MCP_death_uni        = univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted,
  MCP_death_multi      = data.frame(Note = "No cell type reached BH-adjusted p < 0.1 in univariate DSS analyses; multivariable models were not fitted."),
  MCP_recurrence_uni   = univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted,
  MCP_recurrence_multi = multiv_RFS_MCP_selected_formatted
)
wb <- createWorkbook()
for (nm in names(tabs)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, nm)
  writeData(wb, nm, tabs[[nm]], headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold"))
  setColWidths(wb, nm, cols = 1:ncol(tabs[[nm]]), widths = "auto")
}
saveWorkbook(wb, "MCP_survival_with_cutoffs.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
